scope: Research only; no policy/runtime/source changes or saved games. Completed C21 native-template screening only; no validation trajectories.
novelty: Two own pieces close all one-step escapes of one disclosed victim, rather than one actor threatening two fixed victims. Complementary same-target pursuit can be useful; blanket assignment diversity and individual distance goals do not represent capture nets.
gate: Saved native choice quiet; valid public inventory; own Flag unique and not currently capturable by any disclosed/count-feasible enemy including Scout rays.
Candidate legal quiet step creates an adjacent strict-surviving capture threat against a disclosed enemy mobile non-Scout. Moved actor has no immediate count-possible removal after the step.

Enumerate staying and every legal victim quiet escape after source vacancy and public enemy shuttle. A distinct own capable ally plus the moved actor together can strictly-survive capture the victim at every such destination using legal own next-turn geometry and own shuttle.

Both actors have a unique contribution: at least one victim continuation is capturable only by each actor. At least one legal quiet escape exists. All other enemy behavior remains for the certificate, never assumed absent.
selection: Count all gates in all400C21 games. Order gameID,ply,move,victim,ally. Certify first20 eligible ROOTS, first candidate per root; do not select after outcomes. If fewer use all, never relax.
certificate: Native common control: following each public first enemy observation, OR over ALL legal public own continuations, including quiet moves and count-feasible uncertain captures. Candidate while victim alive: netactor captures victim with strict survival, or immediate Flag win; when victim dead: same generalized OR as native. A single chosen own move must succeed under ALL hidden combat outcomes and ALL count-feasible second enemy replies. Unknown quiet identities remain grouped. Positive fixed-root-worth enemy-minus-own material, or own terminalwin; ownFlagloss/no-move/draw refute. Public witness keys must be unique.
budget: Shared20000 yielded enemy outcomes across generalized native control FIRST then candidate; any inconclusive/cap => fallback. No tuning.
mechanical_checks: Public count/lost consistency, masked hidden-nibble invariance, shuttle-sensitive capture and escapes, both actor contributions, synthetic legal capture net and escape/counterwin refutations.
Validate complete copied fixture keys/counts and native replay public board/lost/shuttle on first20. Preserve all proof outputs, timings and source bindings.
interpretation: Opportunity/certificate incidence, not game gain or strength. Strict gate may have zero coverage. Enemy can remove an ally, trade, exploit unknown Scouts or win by Flag; local geometry alone is never proof. Host costs only, no target-fit claim.
